verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Microsoft published a CVE advisory for an Entra ID remote-code-execution flaw (CVSS 10.0, 'claimed no exploits'). The same report says no further detail is likely to be released, so this is minimal disclosure. Community threads about the Actor-token and FIDO downgrade vulnerabilities show the incidents happened, but not how the vendor disclosed them. Missing for 10: published security incident postmortems, a live trust/status page, a documented disclosure policy or history, and first-party evidence of transparent incident write-ups.
